notes.title: Nightwolf: Survive the Megadome is back!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32964518/28d213717ef3d0bda1de9c92f41b3fdbec79ece1.png[/img]

[h3]Attention Megadomers![/h3]

Load your guns and spin your tires, because the beat is on and NIGHTWOLF returns to STEAM!

YES, you've read it right - Nightwolf: Survive the Megadome is once again available on Steam. We've brushed off the dust and fixed some loose screws, so it's time to fire those lasers! 

And this time it is FREE FOR ALL.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/760050/Nightwolf_Survive_the_Megadome/
[h3]What are you still doing here?! The MEGADOME awaits![/h3]

notes.title: The biggest update yet is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/be7ae4bc3296ab0f30387401841d4eb9594567cf.png[/img]

[b]Megadomers![/b]

Drop whatever you’re doing, put on your helmet and grab the wheel because our biggest content update yet is finally available to play and enjoy! This is the last major release before the full launch on May 28 so any and all feedback is in high demand. For details on what features we are introducing, check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/760050/announcements/detail/1815420905476908938]most recent dispatch[/url], or better yet, just fire up the game and see for yourself!

As we told you back in February, this update comes with a slight [b]price increase[/b] that we feel better reflects the breadth of content on display. Please be advised that another price change might accompany the release of the final version of the game, which will feature [b]thrilling cutscenes, redesigned achievements, new voice acting and sound effects[/b] as well as a plethora of graphical improvements. You should also expect a lot of [b]technical improvements[/b] and careful [b]balance tweaks[/b] based entirely on your response to the current version of Nightwolf: Survive the Megadome.

Watch this space to be up to date with what we’re cooking and have fun wrecking fools on the blood-covered arenas of Megadome!



[b]Patch Notes[/b]

This major update to Nightwolf: Survive the Megadome brings you a plethora of changes and fixes, including:

•	Redesigned progression mechanics
•	Two new enemy factions
•	Final boss level
•	Dozens of technical improvements
•	Visual tweaks
•	Partially redesigned UI
•	…and much, much more!

notes.title: IN THE WORKS #6: Approaching the finish line!
notes.content:
[h1]Megadomers![/h1]

In this dispatch, we will [b]share the release date of the final game[/b], as well as [b]describe some of the new content[/b] to be found in the upcoming patch. Read on for details! 

First off, we are overjoyed to announce that the full release of Nightwolf: Survive The Megadome will launch on [b]May 28th, 2019[/b]. It took more time than we anticipated but the finish line is finally in sight! However, you won’t have to wait nearly as long for the [b]next major update[/b], which [b]will become available within the coming weeks[/b].

As we mentioned in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/760050/announcements/detail/3691167087345218496]most recent dispatch[/url], the upcoming patch will [b]introduce the intended game flow[/b], allowing you to reach [b]a number of different conclusions[/b] depending on your performance. Before you take a place on the podium though, you will need to face [b]two all new factions![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/fe9d5f98b34ff403066f8e4a0d198d51e253583c.png[/img]

The terrifying Glowers come from the gloomy pits of refinery ward 234-B. Due to being exposed to the toxic fumes of Unoctanium, the wonder fuel of the future, [b]they developed psychotic tendencies and became both savage and ruthless[/b]. As Megadome’s oldest contender gang, they are here to stay... unless you can do something about it!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/df43c19afde492798f79f55d96cb56ac22b9984e.png[/img]

Fists of Vostok are a group of ex-military personnel, gone into private entertainment sector. Originally coming from the frigid swaths of Siberia, [b]riders of the Fist of Vostok are veterans of the infamous Alaskan Campaign[/b]. After the Seattle peace accords and the amnesty that followed, some of them decided to stay stateside and try their luck in Megadome.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/4557086cc18c3321e555c0292e8bf640353fa57d.png[/img]

But that’s not all! Even if you manage to best both the Glowers and the Fist of Vostok, you will still have to face the ultimate challenge. Not to tip our hand too early, but rest assured that the final battle will get personal! We can’t wait for you to experience that in just a few short weeks... See you then, Megadomers!

notes.title: Content update 0.4.3 out now & development follow up.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/5d2cc5caccfe2598cbf833277c197a0f544cb72f.png[/img]

[b]Megadomers![/b]
We prepared something to keep you busy this Holiday season – a fresh content update! Furthermore, we wish to give a statement on our intended release window. Read on for details!

Content update 0.4.3 brings the following new features:

 [list]
[*]Explore and fight on a brand new arena – Industrial Wasteland! Watch out for flamethrowers and wear a hard hat at all times!

[*]Marvel at the  brand new HUD! We spent a lot of time bringing the art style of the new HUD to the visual quality of the rest of the game and we hope you will agree that it makes a world of difference.
[*]Experience the new lighting system! The game now uses dynamic shadows that bring out the detail and simply make things look better without noticeable performance drops.

[*]Enjoy the many bugfixes and stability improvements. Dozens of under the hood enhancements make the game perform better than ever before.

[/list]

Last but not least, we want to share our plans for finishing the game. It’s December already and despite our initial hopes of releasing the game this year, we can now clearly see that it will be impossible to reach the intended level of quality and breadth of content in those few short weeks. Having taken all options into considerations, we made a tough call to delay the full release of the game to the first quarter of 2019.

We fully understand your disappointment and pledge to do everything in our power to regain your trust. Hopefully you will agree see that each update marks a noticeable improvement. To make sure that production goes according to plan, we have welcomed a sixth member to the team. This person has over ten years of experience in the video game industry and will be serving as our producer in addition to helping us put the finishing touches on game design. Please expect more details at the beginning of the next year.

We all wish you the best for 2019! As always, till next time!

notes.title: Content update 0.3.2 out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/5d2cc5caccfe2598cbf833277c197a0f544cb72f.png[/img]

[b]Megadomers![/b]
Update content is here!

Before we get into details, we owe you an apology. We have really missed our update cycles as of late. Reason for this, as we are slowly gearing towards the final release, we have also started to work on several features simultaneously and started experimenting, and as a result, our production pipeline suffered. We had many too many tasks open, and too few of them were finished. We are hoping now to deliver content in shorter time intervals.

We are happy to introduce you to new game mode – Arena Master. This is a quick horde mode in which you have to survive as long as you can. No upgrades, one life, one car, one arena. The best few players will have their steam nicknames featured in the in-game arena scoreboards for all the other players to see! This mode will also feature its own separate leaderboards.

We are introducing a new faction  – the enigmatic Cyborgs. Little is known about them except for the fact that they have access to better hardware, and depend more on shields than physical robustness to survive. Approach with caution!

Finally, there’s something new for the arsenal. We are introducing a devastating short range weapon – the flamethrower. Roast your enemies for glory!

The visuals have been revised a bit, to better convey that VHS spirit of the world’s most popular TV show – The Megadome.
Also, there’s a hefty amount of bugs that have been taken care of.

Take care, and see you next time!

[h1]Gameplay / Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]New game mode – Arena Master
[*]New enemy faction – Cyborgs
[*]Added area of effect during missile barrage on Vostok arena.
[*]New weapon - flamethrower
[/list]

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated game looks, added VHS effect, and lighting changes.
[*]Physical scoreboard now present during gameplay.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes/Other[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game performance and stability has been improved.
[*]Fixed occlusion culling issue on “Downtown Mayhem” arena.
[*]Improved loading time of “Downtown Mayhem” arena.
[*]Fixed bug where controller settings would not save.
[*]Added regenerated HP amount in the battle store.
[*]Added player’s vehicle model in the battle store.
[*]Fixed bug in which damaged car would spawn in new battle with no damage visible on the model.
[*]Fixed spelling errors in game UI
[/list]

notes.title: Content update 0.2.2 available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/5d2cc5caccfe2598cbf833277c197a0f544cb72f.png[/img]
[b]Megadomers![/b]
Here it is! Another content update!
Fight your way through dark and narrow alleys of “Downtown Mayhem” arena with lots of stuff to destroy - we had a lot of fun making this one and hope you’ll like it too. The look of city background has been improved for all arenas as well. You may notice change in enemy behavior, such as improved obstacle evasion, and higher levels of agility. Now, sometimes the enemies will try to flee, so it’s your duty to prevent this from happening. The game’s performance has been significantly improved, so we hope more of you can have a fluid and seamless gameplay experience now. And finally, we are introducing Dylan Jackson – now you can see the face behind the voice of the Megadome’s anchorman!   

[h1]Gameplay / Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]New arena – “Downtown mayhem”
[*]Enemy AI upgrade
[/list]

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
[list]
[*]Uprated looks of the city background
[*]Introduction of Dylan Jackson as a character
[*]Updated particles
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*]Game performance has been improved
[/list]

notes.title: Content update 0.1.1 out now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/e0bac4eb4ae93523b46deb5651c7d3c733e967f7.png[/img]

[b]Megadomers![/b]
Sorry to keep you waiting but here it is – Content update 0.1.1!
Explore Vostok 3 – brand new arena featuring derelict arctic military installation – or is it truly abandoned? To help you out with progress in game, we are introducing challenges – specific tasks with experience and credit rewards. We have juiced the visuals as well – weapon and powerups now spawn in crates ([i]“Crates away!”[/i]) Since MEGADOME is all about the show, enemies will now appear in drop pods – talk about explosive entry to the game. Moreover, we have enabled complete controls mapping, allowing you to keybind the game the way you like it. And finally Nightwolf: Survive the Megadome now features full controller support!
To sum up:

[h1]Gameplay / Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]New arena – “Vostok 3”
[*]Challenges
[/list]

[h1]Visuals[/h1]
[list]
[*]Uprated particles on Dune arena
[*]Challenges category is now available in gameplay menu
[*]Weapons and powerups now spawn in breakable crates
[*]Enemies now spawn in drop pods
[/list]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*]Full control mapping
[*]Full controller support
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1 is out now!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31870218/cb78af34b64af2865700021323a70d167bd12718.png[/img]

[b]MEGADOMERS! [/b]
The first patch is finally here! Below is the list of changes/fixes:

[h1]Gameplay / Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Health pickup probability has been increased from 14.28% to 40%. Ingame health pickups restore 35 HP instead of 30.
[*]Health consumable price in battle store has been reduced from 900 to 800 credits. Health consumable in battle store now replenishes 50HP instead of 25.
[*]Lowered player’s car center of mass, and increased anti-roll values, to prevent the vehicle from rolling/flipping
[*]Added new enemy, buff and weapon spawns across all arenas.
[*]New ramps added on Warehouse arena, for better movement flow.
[*]Removed containers on the base of the ramp on Dune arena.
[*]Visual improvements on Dune arena.
[*]Ramming is now an unlockable Perk
[*]The previous tutorial was removed, now all gameplay related info is available under HELP in main menu
[/list]
[h1]Audio[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed sound levels for laser
 [/list]
[h1]Visuals[/h1]
[list]
[*]Various changes to user interface.
[*]Fixed bug where the machine gun was pointing to one side
[*]Reworked the looks of battle store
[*]Spelling error fixes in GUI.
[*]Pickup icons now have text description and are more visually indicated upon pickup.
[*]Changed explosive barrel color to red.
[*]Controls are now displayed in the pause menu
[*]Fixed machine gun and autocannon tracer rendering issues 
[/list]

[h1]Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced CPU/GPU usage.
[/list]
